messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Deepa,

Please find attached the first draft of the settlement agreement reflecting the terms agreed in principle. The ex-gratia is shown at £68,000 pending your client's confirmation of the final figure; happy to update to £72,500 on the next turn. Grateful for your mark-up.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher

Tom,

Thank you. Our mark-up is attached. Key points: ex-gratia corrected to £72,500; fee contribution to £1,500; and we've added a fixed period for providing the reference. Otherwise the draft is largely acceptable. If you can accept these we should be able to sign this week.

Deepa
